operational_narrative: Observed pit volume drop at 2965m while penetrating upper Hugin sand. Loss rate measured at 42 bbl/hr. Dynamic ECD was 1.31 SG with 550 GPM pump rate.
mitigation_applied: Pushed 35 bbl medium-coarse CaCO3 and nut-plug LCM pill. Reduced flow rate to 420 GPM and mud density to 1.25 SG. Wellbore stabilized.

operational_narrative: Drillstring became stuck while standing static for 8 minutes to service top-drive connection across depleted Hugin sandstone. Unable to rotate or reciprocate with 80 klbs overpull.
mitigation_applied: Spotted 40 bbl low-toxicity oil-based soaking pill around BHA. Allowed 4 hours soak time while working torque up to 18 kft-lbs. Pipe freed on third jar impact.

operational_narrative: Sudden standpipe pressure increase from 2800 psi to 3550 psi with erratic surface torque up to 22 kft-lbs. Flow paddle dropped indicating annular pack-off.
mitigation_applied: Immediately stopped rotary, picked up off bottom, washed and reamed stand with maximum pump output to dislodge annular solids pack.

operational_narrative: High torque spikes and string stall encountered entering Skagerrak abrasive interval. Shaker screens showed poor cutting returns and large cavings.
mitigation_applied: Pumped high-viscosity tandem sweeps (30 bbl weighted pill followed by 30 bbl low-vis pill). Reamed interval twice before resuming drilling.

operational_narrative: Seepage losses of 18 bbl/hr recorded upon crossing Heather/Hugin boundary.
mitigation_applied: Treated active system with 15 ppb fine nut-plug and blended mica flakes. Losses cured without interrupting drilling.

operational_narrative: Encountered 45 klbs overpull on 8.5 inch BHA during wiper trip at Heather shale transition zone.
mitigation_applied: Reamed tight hole section back to bottom with 90 RPM and circulating 480 GPM. Controlled tripping speed to under 15 m/min.

operational_narrative: Partial losses of 10 bbl/hr in exploration well upon entering Hugin porous sandstone reservoir.
mitigation_applied: Spotted 20 bbl fibrous LCM pill. Formation held 1.28 SG mud weight.

operational_narrative: Losses initiated at 2910m MD in Hugin sand with 38 bbl/hr drop in trip tank. Static fluid level dropped 120m in casing annulus.
mitigation_applied: Spotted 30 bbl medium nut-plug pill and reduced mud weight from 1.30 SG to 1.24 SG. Continued drilling with controlled ROP.

operational_narrative: String packed off in Skagerrak sandstone; standpipe pressure spiked to 3600 psi, zero returns at flow line.
mitigation_applied: Worked drillstring with jarring and pumped heavy viscous sweep to clear annular bridge.

operational_narrative: Excessive drag and 30 klbs overpull observed while pulling out of hole across Smith Bank formation boundary.
mitigation_applied: Backreamed 3 stands to top of liner; increased mud lubricity with 2% glycol addition.
